reviews.comment: Professor Mullins is such a caring and kind professor. I am so glad I was able to take his class for SOCI 420. Definitely take him if you can!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I couldn't recommend Professor Mullins enough. His lectures aren't necessarily required, however they make a huge difference and he does not just read off the slides. His assignments are straightforward with good feedback to use on future assignments, and he is really easy to talk to. His lectures were full of group discussion.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof Mullins is one of the best professors I've had while being at TAMU, he genuinely cares about his students. He strives to not just teach the material but for us to learn and understand it, and he uses real life examples and problems in his lectures. This class is considered the hardest class to take for soci majors and he made it manageble.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He makes the class feel relevant by connecting it to modern topics like AI and encouraging real discussion. His feedback is solid, and he pushes you to think critically without making the class feel intimidating. Some lectures are more traditional, but overall, he's understanding and makes the course worth showing up for.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: WOW! Mullins is one of the most intentional professors ive taken a class with so far at TAMU!! Genuinely cares about each of his students and leaves SUCH detailed and helpful feedback on assignments. Could not recommend a professor more. If you have the chance, PLEASE take his class!! Would give this guy 100 stars if I could!!!

He says he doesn't believe in performative learning (aka he doesn't just read from slides and grade mindlessly, he wants u to truly learn). He gave super helpful feedback on all the assignments when he didn't have to because he cares about his students. Attendance is a sign in sheet. Assignments require a lot of effort and time. Take this class!

Mr. Mullins is a very understanding professor. For a course that is extremely content heavy, he knew that just lecturing the material would not help our class digest the information. His genuine concern for our learning experience was very inspiring and motivated the class to do well on our assignments.

He truly cares about his students' success and does away with traditional PowerPoint lectures. He focuses on group discussions because he believes that discussion-based engagement is invaluable. I have learned a great deal by putting away my laptop and discussing tough concepts. Take this class if you want to do NO math.

I never do Rate My Professor or course evaluations- but his class changed my perspective on university courses and professors (giving me hope in others !). His true care for his students is like nothing I've ever seen in a classroom. Hearing us out, treating us like adults, caring about what we say. It was amazing. One of the best professors here.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is one of the best professors I've had at A&M. I've taken this course before from someone else. Professor Mullins is way better. Also, I think he's an actual genius. In class one day, he went one by one, remembering everyone's individual project by memory and telling us what to do. He cares a lot. 10/10 one of the best.

Professor Mullins is engaged, organized, and teaches with clarity. He works alongside students, using role-reversal and real-time demos to show the power of sociological methods. This summer term was intense, but meaningful. With more time, the course would allow even deeper learning. Highly recommended, take his course! He cares you understand!

He genuinely cares that his students understand the concepts. As long as you show up to class he will work with you and give you guidance with writing assignments. Extremely intelligent and wants to see you succeed. Would absolutely take him again if I could!

SOCI 420 could've been my hardest class at A&M, but Professor Mullins truly cared about us understanding the material. His lectures were clear, feedback was thoughtful, and he made class feel supportive. One of the best professors I've had.

SOCI 420 would have been a disaster because of all the hard concepts, but professor Mullins did his best to make sure that his students are actually learning the materials. His feedbacks were the most helpful, and he genuinely cared about his students. I learned so much through him.

Mullins was one of the best professors I have had during my time at TAMU. He is invested into the material and genuinely cares about the students actually learning the material instead of memorizing for an exam. He was very accessible outside of class and gave great feedback that made us know exactly what he was looking for to succeed in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor made, what I imagined was going to be torturous summer class, not only bearable, but enjoyable. It is very apparent that he cares about the class (both material and students). 10/10 would take again!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mullins took the time to teach us the concepts. He was very accessible after and outside of class! He makes a very difficult class not so difficult. We had 3 papers, 1 midterm, and a presentation. He gives very good feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take his class!! He was so helpful and helped everyone actually understand the concepts rather than memorizing information for tests. There are four essays & a presentation all of which build on one another and one midterm.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mullins took the time to learn, understand, and adapt to the gaps in in-between 220 and 420 and provide information to help us succeed. Our class had 3 writing assignments that he provided in depth feedback for to help us preform well on the final paper. There was also a midterm and presentation which were very fair. 10/10 take him over anyone else

Literally one of the best professors I have ever had. This class consisted of three papers, a midterm exam, and a final paper. After each paper he would provide lot's of helpful feedback. Professor Mullins truly cares about the students and wants us to succeed. Lectures were very entertaining. 

Seriously take this class with professor Mullins!
